name: Shinku Kutsuki
source:
An allegedly talented novelist who got his title from releasing surreal crime thrillers from a young age. Recently he's moved more into Cheesy teen romance novels, which has caused him to receive criticism. But not as much criticism as another recent release...

He seems to struggle a lot with sleep and always looks like he's on the brink of death but is friendly compared to some of the Prisoners. Doesn't seem to do well with being alone for long periods of time. His talent will probably be useful for trials but I don't think his mysteries are that good being honest.

When interrogated about his crime he was completely despondent until we mentioned his sister. Typical. I'm glad I advocated to get this scum in here.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Shinku_Kutsuki_(Danganronpa_Antebellum:_LOCKDOWN)]Wiki[/url]]
